# Models

**Package** `telividb.models.v1`

## Services

### `Models`

Offers a curated set of embedding models, and installs them.  Separate from `telividb.inference.v1`, which is about models already resident and the vectors they produce. This is about acquiring the files: what is on offer, what is present locally, and how far a download has got.  Curated rather than searchable. The encoder implements a fixed set of GGUF architectures, and a model host carries tens of thousands of files that are mostly generative models it cannot read — so a search would mostly return downloads that fail after several hundred megabytes.

| Method | Request | Response | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ListCatalogModels` | `ListCatalogModelsRequest` | `ListCatalogModelsResponse` | Lists the models on offer. |
| `GetCatalogModel` | `GetCatalogModelRequest` | `CatalogModel` | Retrieves one catalog model. |
| `CreateModelInstallation` | `CreateModelInstallationRequest` | `ModelInstallation` | Starts installing a catalog model. Returns as soon as the work is accepted, not when it finishes. A model file is hundreds of megabytes, so the transfer outlives any request deadline; poll the returned installation to follow it. Installing something already present and intact succeeds immediately without transferring anything. |
| `GetModelInstallation` | `GetModelInstallationRequest` | `ModelInstallation` | Retrieves an installation, with its progress. |
| `ListModelInstallations` | `ListModelInstallationsRequest` | `ListModelInstallationsResponse` | Lists installations, most recent first. |
| `DeleteModelInstallation` | `DeleteModelInstallationRequest` | `ModelInstallation` | Cancels an installation, or forgets a finished one. Cancelling leaves the partial file in place, so installing again resumes rather than starting over. |

## Messages

### `CatalogModel`

A model the server offers to install, verified against the file it names.  Curated rather than searched. The encoder implements a fixed set of GGUF architectures, and model hosts carry tens of thousands of files that are mostly generative models it cannot read — so a search would mostly return downloads that fail. Every field here was read from the actual file or from the host's API, never copied from a model card.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | `IDENTIFIER` | Resource name of the catalog model. |
| `display_name` | `string` | 2 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Name shown to a person choosing. |
| `description` | `string` | 3 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | What this model is good for, in terms someone can act on. Bigger is not simply better: width costs index size and query latency, so the description says what the trade buys. |
| `repository_uri` | `string` | 4 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Page for these weights, for checking licence and provenance at the source. |
| `digest` | `string` | 5 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | SHA-256 of the model file, as sixty-four lowercase hex characters. The identity, not the label. Two files under one name produce different vectors, and mixing them into one index degrades recall with nothing reporting it. Verified after download; a mismatch is refused. |
| `size_bytes` | `int64` | 6 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Exact size of the file in bytes. Exact rather than rounded, because a progress indicator divides by it. |
| `modality` | `Modality` | 7 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | What this model embeds. |
| `architecture` | `string` | 8 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | GGUF architecture, read from the file's own header. |
| `dimensions` | `int32` | 9 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Components in the vectors it produces. A vector field bound to this model must declare the same width. |
| `context_length` | `int32` | 10 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Maximum input length in tokens; longer input is truncated. |
| `quantization` | `string` | 11 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Quantization the file carries, such as `Q8_0`. |
| `license` | `string` | 12 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | SPDX identifier for the weights' licence. |
| `recommended` | `bool` | 13 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Whether this is the default offer for a caller with no preference. Exactly one catalog model sets this. Two defaults is a choice presented as a recommendation, which leaves the caller no better off. |
| `installed` | `bool` | 14 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Whether the file is present locally at its full length. Cheap to answer, and deliberately not a digest check: a listing asks this once per model every time it is shown. The digest is verified before the model is loaded, which is the moment it matters. |
| `resident` | `bool` | 15 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Whether the model is loaded and able to serve requests now. Distinct from `installed`, and the distinction is the useful one: a model is downloaded seconds before it is resident, because reading several hundred megabytes of weights onto a device takes time. A caller that treats "installed" as "ready" sends text during that window and is refused. |

### `ModelInstallation`

One attempt to install a catalog model.  A resource rather than a blocking call, because a model file is hundreds of megabytes: an install outlives any request deadline, has to survive a restart, and has to be cancellable. Creating this returns immediately with a handle; progress is read back by getting it.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | 1 | `IDENTIFIER` | Resource name of the installation. |
| `catalog_model` | `string` | 2 |  | The catalog model being installed. |
| `state` | `InstallationState` | 3 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | How far it has got. |
| `progress_bytes` | `int64` | 4 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Bytes written so far, including any resumed from an earlier attempt. Cumulative rather than per-attempt, so a resumed install shows a bar that continues instead of restarting. |
| `total_bytes` | `int64` | 5 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Total bytes expected, copied from the catalog entry. |
| `error` | `string` | 6 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | Why it failed, when `state` is `FAILED`. A digest mismatch is reported here rather than as a transport error: the file arrived intact and is not the file the catalog names, which is a different problem with a different remedy. |
| `create_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 7 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When the installation was created. |
| `update_time` | `google.protobuf.Timestamp` | 8 | `OUTPUT_ONLY` | When its state last changed. |

### `ListCatalogModelsRequest`

Request message for listing catalog models.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `page_size` | `int32` | 1 | `OPTIONAL` | Maximum number to return. The server may return fewer. |
| `page_token` | `string` | 2 | `OPTIONAL` | Page token from a previous response. |
| `filter` | `string` | 3 | `OPTIONAL` | Restricts the results, using the standard filter grammar. `modality = "text"` is the one worth knowing: every other modality is empty today, because no encoder exists for it. |

### `CreateModelInstallationRequest`

Request message for starting an installation.

| Field | Type | # | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `model_installation` | `ModelInstallation` | 1 | `REQUIRED` | The installation to create. Only `catalog_model` is read. |
| `model_installation_id` | `string` | 2 | `OPTIONAL` | Client-chosen identifier for the installation. Supplying one makes the call idempotent: repeating it returns the existing installation rather than starting a second transfer of the same file. |

## Enums

### `Modality`

What a model turns into vectors.

| Value | # | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `MODALITY_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | Unspecified. Never returned by the server. |
| `MODALITY_TEXT` | 1 | Natural-language text, and the only modality with an encoder behind it. |
| `MODALITY_IMAGE` | 2 | Still images. No loadable architecture yet. |
| `MODALITY_AUDIO` | 3 | Speech or general audio. No loadable architecture yet. |
| `MODALITY_VIDEO` | 4 | Video. No loadable architecture yet. |

### `InstallationState`

How far an installation has got.

| Value | # | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `INSTALLATION_STATE_UNSPECIFIED` | 0 | Unspecified. Never returned by the server. |
| `INSTALLATION_STATE_PENDING` | 1 | Accepted and waiting to start. |
| `INSTALLATION_STATE_DOWNLOADING` | 2 | Transferring bytes. |
| `INSTALLATION_STATE_VERIFYING` | 3 | Transferred; the digest is being checked against the catalog. |
| `INSTALLATION_STATE_SUCCEEDED` | 4 | Installed, verified, and ready once the engine next starts. |
| `INSTALLATION_STATE_FAILED` | 5 | Stopped without installing. `error` says why. |
| `INSTALLATION_STATE_CANCELLED` | 6 | Cancelled by a caller deleting the installation. |
